answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS how_many
FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON s.country_code = c.country_code
WHERE
  s.is_online = FALSE AND c.country_name = 'Germany' AND NOT s.close_date IS NULL
